title: Whale with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5bb8f0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2a6fa8'/>

  <path d='M14 56 Q12 40 26 32 Q42 24 58 30 Q74 36 78 52 Q80 64 70 68 Q52 74 34 70 Q18 66 14 56 Z' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <path d='M42 28 Q44 18 52 16 Q50 24 50 29 Z' fill='#3d86c0' stroke='#6cc4f5' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <path d='M30 24 Q28 18 31 14' fill='none' stroke='#bfeaff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
